guards: Only exact source-native family and one accepted displayed birth/death field.
All explicit aliases, including blank values, retain their source priority.
Foreign migration is not repeated and no other biography field or fact is replayed.
The citation-date option does not govern biography dates.
Paired birth/death presentation retains the existing source-bound Morte rule before standalone formatting.
